name: Something Custom
snippet: Have something special in mind? Let's talk.
story: Sometimes the right piece just doesn't exist yet — so I make it. I take a limited number of custom orders beyond my usual work. The best way to start is to reach out and describe what you have in mind. I'll let you know honestly whether it's something I can take on and what it would cost.
details_text:
✏️ Possibilities: Bowls, decorative pieces, platters, garden angels, and more
💬 How to order: Contact me to describe your idea
🍽️ Safety: All functional pieces food safe and dishwasher safe
⏱️ Turnaround: ~6 weeks from confirmation
📦 Shipping: USPS flat rate nationwide
